author: Nathaniel77
quote: 13 years of development and 100 dollars for glitchy chore simulator, that runs at 30 FPS at best. Incredibly boring main character and unlikable female love interest. No autosave and clunky combat controls. The only positive are beautiful and realistic visuals, which are nothing special in 2026. A bad game, which shouldn´t have even been allowed to enter Game of the year 2026.
